notes.title: QOL Update : The Fifth Roadmap Update for Sprite's Honor is Complete!
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44903619/85ef8df7e1aee1e1c216792b2000ce9b212df365.png"]

Hello, it’s Holographicquad! And we're back with another roadmap update. Phase 5: “Quality of Life🌊” of the Sprite’s Honor roadmap is now complete! The QOL changes focused on enhancing the ease of the gameplay experience. 



Here's some of what's new - > 🌊

- Added click and hold to Teal's working

- Added click and hold to zoom buttons

- Added code to character cycling

- Made opening the battle stump require a double click 

- Refactored house code to fix many issues

- Refactored dialogue code to fix many issues

- Refactored save system

- Can now swap between fairies inside homes

- added emote above fairies who need unpacking 

- fixed issues with Seedling pens 

- fixed issues with gifting

- fixed issues with rewards from diving

- Added feature for swapping through tips in oakpedia

- fixed issues with pause menu buttons

- added click and hold to auto feeder buttons

- fixed issues with talking animations

- fixed issues and visual issues with special items in the shop

- fixed the issue where the fast-forward button was breaking the battle

- added visuals to the fast-forward effect in battling

- fixed issues with debris 

- Dia will now show in early cutscenes if unlocked

- Every menu can now be exited with ESC

- When picking your buddy seedling, you can now use mouse clicks

- fixed objects and data that were not correctly loading in after save

- added new tips

- fixed issues with animations during dialogue

- fixed issues when upgrading and selecting characters in the bulletin board 

- added an option in settings to turn off foreground grass

- increased the amount of friendship points you can get

- Clicking resources now will automatically give you the max amount (depending on strength stat)

- added the ability to hover over the house sign and see who owns it

- added sleeping dialogue

- fixed issues when stalk seeding was holding weapons and playing correctly 

- added a button to call all unassigned seedlings to the player

- changed: two items will unlock instead of one after a certain number of days

- Seedling population is now tracked

- fixed numbers showing as decimals after loading in 

- added money reward for beating gnome battles

- added sound to picking seedling dust

- fixed issues with destroying occupied houses

- made the light area of light sources bright

- fixed issues when energy bar wasn't filling if fairy went to bed late

- And many other bug fixes!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44903619/2330122d775ffa860d6a24471842fb38c3257506.png"]

Things to look out for after updating
[p align="start"]Save files: Any saves from before this update will not work correctly. I apologize for the inconvenience. However, this QOL update has made significant changes to the save system, so this may not be an issue in future updates. Unfortunately, the code for the save system was done earlier, and it was my first time building such a system.😅
[p align="start"]Bugs: As always, new updates can introduce new issues. Please report any bugs you encounter, and we’ll squash them as we work toward the next update!
[p align="start"]We appreciate your support and hope you enjoy the update. See you next time, bye-bye! 👋✨

notes.title: Automation Update : The Third Roadmap Update for Sprite's Honor is Complete!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44903619/1df9914c4b648e725f99e25afb98181233bb3c92.png


Hello, it's Holographicquad, and we are back with another update. Phase 3: 'Automation Update' of Sprite's Honor Road map is now completed. The Automation Update set out to make working on the island easier. While this is a smaller update it adds some cool stuff! Including new gizmos, and it changes a few design choices. Here's what's new! ->

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44903619/2bd6a6078604900d2501fb18f1ad42cd670ea9ef.gif

🏭Automation Updates:
- The Gem Polisher now has an easier to read UI resembling the Kiln's.
- The nest is no longer a pocket item for easier access and faster farming. The nests are now on the island grounds.
- New Gizmo: The Seedling feeder is a new item that attaches to the seedling feeder and automatically dispenses food!
- New Gizmo: The dust collector is a vacuum-like item that automatically collects fairy dust dropped by your seedlings!
- Signs: On the map, we now added signs for seeds, nests, and resource locations.
- Added the icons for the player holding items versus Teal holding items.
- Shop: Fixed issues with the shop displaying incorrect information, changed visuals for shop trade artwork.
- New visual transitions
- added some missing sound assets 
- And many bug fixes!


As always, with new updates, in-game issues and bugs may come. We'd appreciate it if you reported any you run into to us! 


Thanks for reading, we can't wait for you to play! ✨

notes.title: Devlog #004 (Seedling houses)
notes.content:
Hello! It's Holographicquad (the dynamic game development Duo). 
We are currently working on a Fairy game called Sprite's Honor and....

It's time for the 4th Devlog!

'Seedling Houses'

🧚🏾‍♀️✨🍄🧚🏾‍♀️✨🍄🧚🏾‍♀️✨🍄🧚🏾‍♀️✨🍄🧚🏾‍♀️✨🍄🧚🏾‍♀️✨🍄🧚🏾‍♀️✨🍄🧚🏾‍♀️✨🍄🧚🏾‍♀️✨🍄🧚🏾‍♀️

Art👩‍🎨
Really teeny art section this week! My only contribution was the art for the birdhouse-inspired seedling houses, which are both practical (protecting your seedlings) and decorative (looking pretty). Lots of customization options has always been a feature we've wanted to include in Sprite's Honor, so I created several styles and colors to personalize the island. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44903619/64f58386263f51469641c48976b4efab534ee806.gif

That's all for now!

Programming 👩‍💻

Here is my recap on coding the seedling homes!

The seedling houses are a simple node consisting of a collision shape and an area node that detects if the house is on the ground or in the air. This is so the player is only allowed to place the house up in the trees, if the area detects ground it won't allow the player to place it.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44903619/14880420cb67b174038b463b5c6274936a646777.gif

Next I wanted to create a rope that reacted to movement and was physics based. I realized that someone had already made a 2d physics based rope addon which was super helpful. There was only a little tweaking to get the addon to work with my node!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44903619/06be18c65726577d8aee8007da5d823c6c9307cf.gif


The last thing I did was allow the seedlings to be put inside and taken out. The player clicks on the seedling then the house and the house adds that seedling node to an array and the seedling node is paused and hidden.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44903619/c0bf8119d869539aa2d8c5eec7308422ed63eca7.gif

🧚🏾‍♀️✨🍄🧚🏾‍♀️✨🍄🧚🏾‍♀️✨🍄🧚🏾‍♀️✨🍄🧚🏾‍♀️✨🍄🧚🏾‍♀️✨🍄🧚🏾‍♀️✨🍄🧚🏾‍♀️✨🍄🧚🏾‍♀️✨🍄🧚🏾‍♀️✨🍄🧚🏾‍♀️✨🍄🧚🏾‍♀️✨

Thanks for tuning into our weekly Devlog! 👋

You can watch the video version here!

notes.title: Devlog #003 ( Battling & The Scout Fairy Bramble⚔️)
notes.content:
Hello! It's Holographicquad (the dynamic game development Duo). 


We are currently working on a Fairy game called Sprite's Honor and.... It's time for the 3rd Devlog!

'Battling & Bramble⚔️'



🧚🏾‍♀️✨🍄🧚🏾‍♀️✨🍄🧚🏾‍♀️✨🍄🧚🏾‍♀️✨🍄🧚🏾‍♀️✨🍄🧚🏾‍♀️✨🍄🧚🏾‍♀️✨🍄🧚🏾‍♀️✨🍄🧚🏾‍♀️✨🍄🧚🏾‍♀️

Art👩‍🎨

Because Bramble, the scout sprite, is injured and walks instead of flying for some of the gameplay, he needed two sets of animations. I had created only his walk and but not his flying, so I finished those first. After his 4-direction movement, he needed several more "action" animations, most importantly his attack. 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44903619/1dfa345222bf84b1f7ce47c22cde5f0d01fd25b4.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44903619/f6b5ac06c3c097638bc982a15bfd416df8de07f8.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44903619/93411c8e0d09be12fc77a47d31e0a90636dfc4ae.gif

Next, I moved onto the actual battle scene. The gnome king got a facelift, making his outfit slightly fancier and making him larger than regular gnomes.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44903619/249b6d56cd4d699cc8984e35d763e6cac1b09105.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44903619/8d5720207a49979c1e3b1416a22db35f9006e7da.gif
Cape flap!

The last thing I tackled was UI for getting to battle. The UI in place was flawed so we reevaluated what was needed, then I fiddled with elements and organization until I was satisfied with it. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44903619/8e7e7e05b3e9286f513f21b5b6098dc3d162c0d2.gif

As always, I'm excited to see everything implemented in-game!

Later!

Programming 👩‍💻
Hey! Here's my recap on programming the battling aspects.

First I went back and touched up the battle levels. I went through all five levels added in the different level art and added the King gnome new art in. I also fixed some leftover bugs and changed the way the battle scene loads in.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44903619/c2837b9fbd9385f7cf00160dbf9df66948fa981d.gif

Once that was done, it was time to make battles happen back on your camping site.

First I created gnomes that will come into your campsite and try to pillage.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44903619/5250f66a79631d32ae096611408301e38011e274.gif

Next, I coded Bramble. I made him able to attack and made his stamina bar deplete when gnomes land their attacks.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44903619/63a7913004941af8074ea8ca38de7aaba6b7037a.gif

This took a while to get working as there were many parts to code - the seedlings, Bramble, and the gnomes. But once I got it all working I was pretty proud of the outcome :D .

🧚🏾‍♀️✨🍄🧚🏾‍♀️✨🍄🧚🏾‍♀️✨🍄🧚🏾‍♀️✨🍄🧚🏾‍♀️✨🍄🧚🏾‍♀️✨🍄🧚🏾‍♀️✨🍄🧚🏾‍♀️✨🍄🧚🏾‍♀️✨🍄🧚🏾‍♀️✨🍄🧚🏾‍♀️✨🍄🧚🏾‍♀️✨
